Stay vigilant!

Cases of respiratory illnesses like HMPV are on the rise. Protect yourself: wash hands, wear masks in crowded places, and stay home if unwell. 

Let’s care for our health & others, Dr. Haleema Yazdani 🌟

#HMPV Covid #HMP
